utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Just cover whatever you can. I’ll make sure the rest gets handled.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I’ve got a couple of tools and I can lend a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good, I was just about to ask if you’d still got those tools. Let’s take a look at the repair drive and see what’s actually changed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, let’s check what’s changed and make sure I still have the right tools for the job.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is picking up speed, and folks are dropping off supplies by the hour. Pia, if you need the latest list, I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please send the list. I want to make sure I’m not missing anything before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, I’ll send you the list right now. It’s the usual mix so far: boxes, tape, bottled water, and a few tool kits.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Opal. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, Sam. The repair drive is the lane by the old post office, and the broken gate is near the end of it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Opal. I’ll head down the lane by the old post office and check the gate at the end.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive's happening? Count me in, I can spread the word and help out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll start spreading the word today and see if anyone can lend a hand too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo. I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I’ll make sure we cover the urgent fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I can help with the urgent ones first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, then we’ll get through the urgent fixes together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What exactly needs repairing, and when are you hoping to get it done?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the roof leak in the back room and that loose step by the porch. I was hoping to get it done this weekend if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that should work if the weather holds, and I’ll help make sure we check both the roof leak and the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup. What time does the repair drive need me there?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: After school pickup works fine. Come by around 4:30, and I’ll be there to get things started.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll be there at 4:30 after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard about the repair drive second-hand, so what's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s moving along: the crew has a few repairs lined up, and I can fill you in on the details if you want the short version.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, give me the short version.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean the repair drive is still on for today?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, it’s still on for today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, let me think... I might have the list somewhere, but I can’t quite recall it right now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No rush, just let me know when you find it and we can go through it together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. Tell Cleo I’m on it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Vik. I’ll keep that in mind and let the others know you’re on it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’m on it. I’ll tell Cleo the repair drive’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along, but I haven’t got the details yet. I’ll let you know if I pick up anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good. Let me know if you hear anything more.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can help with that repair drive, Vik, though I might need you to remind me what we’re fixing. I’m happy to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive. Just point me to the thing that’s broken, and I’ll do my best to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think I heard about that, but I might've missed the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it’s still going. I can fill you in on the latest when you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, definitely fill me in when you’ve got a minute.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli. I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d help. I’ll stop by with my list and we can see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that. I’ll check in about the repair drive and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Mara. I’ll spread the word and let folks know you’re checking on it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’ll check on it and let you know what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that repair drive, Opal. Tell me what still needs to be done.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can bring the drill, the replacement screws, and the outlet cover from the garage. After that, we still need to check the wiring and test the switch.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, that covers the parts list. I can handle the wiring check and switch test once you bring the gear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’ll make sure we keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good, I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and make sure nothing slips through the cracks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, let’s keep close tabs on it and touch base if anything needs a quick fix.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive got a pretty good turnout. What did Mina say about what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: She said we still need hands for cleanup, a few tools, and someone with a truck.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, so cleanup, tools, and a truck are still on the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that. What part of the repair drive needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can sort the list and make sure the school timing works around it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just keep me posted on the timing and I’ll handle the repair side.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean the repair drive itself, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I mean the repair drive itself. What should I bring?
